questions.q: According to this lesson, what did the five earlier courses in the Microsoft Data & BI Developer program teach, compared to what this capstone taught?
options: The earlier courses were unnecessary preparation for this capstone
The earlier courses taught the individual pieces in isolation; this capstone taught making every one of those pieces agree with every other one on a single business process
This capstone repeated the same content as the five earlier courses
The earlier courses taught only theory, with no hands-on practice
questions.explain: T-SQL Development, SSIS Development, SSRS Development, Power BI, and Data Modeling & Data Warehousing each taught one piece. This capstone is where those pieces had to work together for the first time.

questions.q: Which course's teaching shows up in dw.FactWorkOrder's design as an accumulating snapshot with role-playing date keys?
options: Data Modeling & Data Warehousing
SSRS Development
T-SQL Development
Power BI
questions.explain: Dimensional design — fact table types, role-playing dimensions, and conformed dimensions — is Data Modeling & Data Warehousing's contribution to this capstone.

questions.q: Which two deliverables does this lesson say prove the architecture 'holds together end to end'?
options: Two separate warehouses, one for each tool
A report and a dashboard that both read the same warehouse tables
A resume and a cover letter
Two SSIS packages that duplicate each other's work
questions.explain: WorkOrderProductionSummary.rdl and the Power BI dashboard both reading dw.FactWorkOrder and its dimensions is the proof that the shared-warehouse architecture actually works.

questions.q: How does this lesson describe LTV Academy's catalog beyond this program?
options: It has other advanced tracks and specializations available for whenever a student is ready to go further, with no pressure to choose immediately
It names several specific unreleased courses the student must enroll in next
It says this program is the final course LTV Academy will ever offer
It says no further courses exist beyond this program
questions.explain: The lesson keeps this general and encouraging — pointing at the existence of further tracks without naming specific ones or pressuring an immediate decision.

questions.q: What combination does this lesson say separates 'a finished course' from 'a finished career step'?
options: A certificate of completion alone
Memorizing every SQL keyword covered in the program
Finishing all 25 lessons without reading any of the guides
A real, working project plus the ability to explain it confidently to someone else
questions.explain: The lesson emphasizes that the finished pipeline only becomes a career asset when paired with the five-part walkthrough skill built in Lesson 24.
